description: This PHP file defines a class 'ADODB2_db2' that extends 'ADODB_DataDict' to provide database schema management functionalities specifically for IBM DB2 databases within the ADOdb abstraction layer. It includes methods for type conversion, altering columns, dropping columns, and changing table schemas tailored to DB2.

classes.name: ADODB2_db2
classes.description: A class for managing and manipulating DB2 database schemas within the ADOdb PHP framework.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Returns the actual database type corresponding to a given meta type, considering custom meta types if defined.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Generates additional SQL suffixes for column definitions, including default values, nullability, and constraints.

methods.name: alterColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to alter existing columns in a DB2 table based on provided field definitions.

methods.name: dropColumnSql
methods.description: Generates SQL statement(s) to drop specified columns from a DB2 table.

methods.name: changeTableSQL
methods.description: Creates SQL statements to modify a table's schema, altering columns or creating the table if it does not exist.
